copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件通道:复制并注册适配器、安装固定版本依赖、构建与跑测试,再引导你填 API key、发信地址和 webhook 密钥,并把你注册为 owner 发出问候邮件。
howto.when: 当你运行 /setup 或想给 NanoClaw 增加邮件收发渠道时使用;需要 Resend 账号、已验证的发信域名和 API key。

say.text: 帮我把 Resend 邮件通道加到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 会复制并注册适配器、装依赖、跑构建和测试

say.text: 收不到别人的邮件了,帮我查一下 webhook 配置
say.note: 会核对 webhook 地址与签名密钥

howto.what_en: Adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs @resend/chat-sdk-adapter, builds and runs the test, then walks you through API key, from-address and webhook secret and wires you as owner with a hello email.
howto.when_en: Use when you run /setup or want to add email send/receive to NanoClaw. Needs a Resend account, a verified sending domain and an API key.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, installs it, builds and tests

say_en.text: My email is me@example.com; let the nanobot agent answer it
say_en.note: Registers you as owner and sends a hello email

say_en.text: Inbound email stopped arriving — check the webhook setup
say_en.note: Checks the webhook URL and signing secret
